decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the land shall be restored to the state as specified in the notes attached to this condition no later than the 20/03/2013 or when the use has permanently ceased, whichever is the earlier, in accordance with the approved plans and supporting information as detailed in Condition 2 below.
The land shall be restored to the state as indicated on drawing no. AC07H_p_005-A as submitted.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (AC07H_p_005-A, AC07H_p_010-F, AC07H_p_030-G, AC07H_p_035-A, AC07H_p_040-E, Location Plan, Planning, Design & Access Statement October 2012, Transport Statement October 2012, Ecological Appraisal October 2012 (EED12911-100_R_2_1_3_HMB), Flood Risk Assessment October 2012 received 29/10/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The development permitted by this planning permission shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) ref 26736/001 dated 25 Oct 2012 produced by PBA and the following mitigation measures detailed within the FRA: 
1.	Provision of open voids below marquees to allow conveyance and temporary storage of floodwater 
2.	establishment of maintenance regime to ensure the void area remains operational 
3.	Identification and provision of safe route(s) into and out of the site to an appropriate safe haven. 
4.	Finished floor levels are set no lower than 9.59m above Ordnance Datum (AOD). 

The mitigation measures shall be fully implemented prior to occupation and subsequently in accordance with the timing/phasing arrangements embodied within the scheme, or within any other period as may subsequently be agreed, in writing, by the local planning authority.
description: Temporary use of land to the south and west of the existing building commencing on 29/10/2012 and ending on 20/03/2013 during the 2012 Rugby Internationals and the 2013 Six Nations Championship for the operation of a temporary corporate hospitality facility at Twickenham Access Self Storage.
